metadata.affinity_note: sets.A / sets.G generated by add_affinity_pairs.py (seed 9517): 16/200 jobs in affinity pairs, 6/200 in anti-affinity pairs.  Pairs avoid precedence-linked jobs, each job appears at most once, affinity pairs share replica count and have overlapping eligibility, anti-affinity pairs have enough distinct eligible servers to sit apart.
metadata.note: Synthetic jobs: log-normal(2.5,0.8) durations, bimodal resources, 40 % critical, geometric(0.55) replicas. Distributions fitted to Alibaba 2021 GPU cluster trace (Weng et al. 2022, USENIX ATC '22). Precedence patterns: chains/fanout from Qiao et al. (2021, OSDI) and Weng et al. (2022).
metadata.resource_split_note: Scalar r replaced by r_cpu (=original r; drives power/heat/wear/noise) and r_mem generated via a Gaussian copula with rank correlation 0.5 to CPU, then mapped through the empirical CPU marginal so memory shares the same distribution shape. The two resources are correlated but genuinely distinct (~19% of jobs are CPU-heavy/memory-light or the reverse), so vector bin packing is meaningful.
